change_log.value: Define request/response schema for clinical trials search including condition, location, recruiting status, eligibility summary, and optional travel metrics.
Implement ClinicalTrials.gov API integration with recruiting filter, condition/location query handling, and structured parsing of trial data.
Add optional travel distance and duration enrichment using Google Routes API based on user location and trial sites.
Expose clinical trials search via EvaluateCare facade and tool router with validated inputs and structured output for chat consumption.
Create unit and integration tests covering API fetch, parsing, enrichment, and facade-level response validation.
